name: Don Benito (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and red in the proportions 2:1, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Don Benito (a castle and keys on blue).
history: The flag is rectangular of proportions 2:3, formed of two vertical stripes of 2/3 and 1/3 of the length, white next to the staff charged with the municipal arms and red at the fly.

features.role: Don Benito arms — castle and keys on blue
